input: All graph nodes; no subgraph selector, no PCA. Observed-only per-channel RMS without centering, +/-10 clip. Native feature pairs. Finite value state plus explicit original missing-mask embedding; no ordinary input recentering that can destroy singleton observations. This common interface differs from the official preprocessing recipe and previous pilots.
model: Public GraphPFN 1.3 + LimiX checkpoints. Existing graph adapters, feature encoder and label decoder train; original LimiX transformer weights stay frozen. Shared refiner within an arm, four steps. Frontend and interleaved have exactly the same parameters and number of steps. Plain controls receive a small generic token residual adapter at the same four layers; parameter counts are reported, not assumed identical.
refiner: Clamped numeric feature state. Per-feature-pair shared network sees current values, neighbor means, original observation masks and neighbor observation fractions, plus low-dimensional projections of current feature/label tokens and neighbor tokens. Predict bounded numeric innovation and a mixing gate. Interleaved injects differences of the common numeric encoder into feature tokens before layers 0/3/6/9. Frontend performs all four updates on input tokens before layer 0. No feature reconstruction or auxiliary objective.
supervision: Synthetic query cross entropy only. Query labels and hidden values are targets/diagnostics, never forward inputs. Test graphs use context labels only and no weight updates. Every arm/seed has the same task and forward-RNG schedule; final checkpoint only.
primary: Graph-paired NLL: interleaved must beat frontend and both continued-training plain controls on uniform missing and clustered missing, with paired 95% CI below zero. Also report accuracy, Brier, full-feature behavior, all individual conditions and seed effects. Secondary k=1 and cell missing are not promoted after inspection. No claim of novel method or real-graph zero-shot transfer from this small same-family pilot.
bootstrap: 5000 paired graph resamples after averaging mask settings and the three training seeds within each graph; training seeds are held fixed, not population uncertainty. Report each seed separately. No multiplicity correction.
scope: New graphs from a size-restricted official prior, not unseen semantic schema. Graph size/feature/class limits and invalid-generator retries are documented. No target fitting, test-tuned stopping or automatic rescue with more loss/updates. This tests explicit numeric-state feedback, not all joint imputation models.
